subdivision.heading: Assessment of Costs by Assessment Officer

operative_text.controlling:
10.43(1)  An assessment officer’s decision must be given by an
interim or final certificate, which may be endorsed on a bill of
costs, and which must
(a) certify the amount to be paid by each party or person,
(b) certify any special circumstance and the amount to be paid
by each party or person with respect to the special
circumstance, and
(c) be dated and signed by the assessment officer.
(2)  A certificate that meets the requirements stated in subrule (1) is
conclusive proof of the amount that a party or person who had
notice of the assessment must pay.
